rows.en:
(Ahh, classes are finally over~!
Guess I'll head home.)
(Huh? There's someone I don't recognize, from behind...)
(Looks like a woman with a really great figure...)
(Was there anyone like that at this school...?)
(Ah, she turned around!)
rows.notes: 'she': the previous row in both versions says it is a woman.

rows.en: Hm? What's wrong, \p?
What's the matter? Why are you making that face?

Oh, it's just that you're dressed differently
from how I usually see you...

Ah, this?
Well, I can't exactly commute in a tracksuit.
Does it look strange?
No, it looks most becoming on you.
rows.notes: Over-polite keigo in the Japanese (flustered player): kept stiff in English; Hilda calls it odd next.

rows.en:
What's with you? You're a strange one...
Well, whatever. Get home safe.
(So that's how Hilda-sensei dresses normally...)

(Haah~, classes are finally over~!
Time to head home.)
(Huh? Someone I don't recognize, from behind...)
(Looks like a woman with a really great figure...)
Oh?! Hilda-sensei?

Oh, it's just that you're dressed
differently from usual...
No, it looks super good on you!

I see. Thank you.
Flattery or not, that makes me a little happy.
(Hilda-sensei's casual clothes... they're kinda nice...)

(I came to the Shibuya Area to buy a swimsuit,
but which shop should I go to?)

Well, if it isn't \p.
Out shopping?

Oh, Hilda-sensei.
Yes, I was thinking of buying a new swimsuit.

A swimsuit?
What, are you going to the artificial island?

No, I don't have any plans like that right now,
but I wanted one in a new design.

Oh, speaking of which, have you heard?
There's a rumor lately that a ghost appears
in a cave on the artificial island.
G-ghost, you say...?

Huh, you haven't heard?
It's pretty famous. Supposedly Alto and the others
have even seen it...

...I-I see! That's terrible.
Oh, I just remembered something I have to do...
See you!
O-okay... See you.

(Could it be that Hilda-sensei is surprisingly
scared of ghost stories and stuff...?)

Huh, you haven't heard?
It's pretty famous. Supposedly Saotome-kun
and the others have even seen it...

(Summer break's almost over...
What should I do?)

\p.
What are you doing in a place like this?
I'm bored, so I was just wandering around.

...Why don't you try spending your vacation
a little more productively?
Productively? But I don't even have any money...
In that case, go to the library or something and study.
...W-well then, I'll be going now.
Make sure you study hard!
(...Okay, what should I do for fun?)
I'm bored, so I was just out for a stroll.
Productively? But I don't even have any moneyyy...
...W-well then, I'll be going now.
(Sheryl's concert is almost here!)

\p.
What are you so giddy about?

What about? Sensei, it's Sheryl's concert!
Aren't you interested?
Hm, is that so.
"Is that so"...? Do you even know who Sheryl is?
I do. The Galactic Fairy, Sheryl Nome, correct?

Her singing, her looks, her live performances...
she's a top-level artist in every respect today.
You know all that, and you're not excited at all?

I am excited, you know.
I'm planning to go to the concert, too.
...You don't look it at all, though.

Never mind me. Stop getting carried away
and focus on your studies.

(A new planet's been found, but
I still can't help feeling uneasy...)

Who's that over there...?
Yamashiro-sensei!
\p, is it?
Sensei, what do you think about the new planet?
That's a rather vague question...

...Well, one thing I can say is
that reaching a new planet
doesn't mean it's all over.

The real beginning comes after we get there.
There's no use worrying about it already.

You're right...
Hearing you say that, Sensei, I feel a lot better somehow.

Hm. If this sort of talk helps, I'll oblige anytime.
Now, I'll be taking my leave.

(Like Yamashiro-sensei said,
there's no use worrying about it already.)

(A new planet's been found, but
I still can't help feeling uneasy...)

(Like Yamashiro-sensei said,
there's no use worrying about it already, right?)
